title: FounderStack: 'Another tool. Another subscription.' bundle pricing promo
summary: A tight 15 s SaaS bundle ad in two halves. Dark navy half: 'Another tool.' / 'Another subscription.' (pink) with floating subscription chips and a running monthly cost counter ($303 -> $648 -> $1,176/mo), slammed 'Single.', a chevron burst into the FounderStack logo, quick product logos (Aidbase, SignupGate), angled UI collage 'Four tools. One', grid of features 'All the founder essentials.'. Light half: serif 'Pay once. / Use forever.' (italic blue) with struck-through monthly prices and an infinity line, '50,000+' stat, end card with CTA pill. HUD corner marks and mono metadata frame every shot.
fit_reason: Directly on-message for SaaSSuite: tool-sprawl pain -> one stack, clear pricing, navy + blue palette very close to our placeholder brand; mixes punchy sans with calm serif for a premium feel.

typography.display: tight geometric grotesk bold (General Sans / Satoshi-like) for punch lines; classic book serif (Tiempos/GT Super-like) for the light 'Pay once. Use forever.' section with italic blue emphasis; mono small caps for HUD metadata ('FS/26 — 05 · THE DEAL', 'FRAME 0654 / 60FPS')

typography.notes: Colour rule: pain word in pink #EE3065 ('subscription.'), positive/brand word in blue #0A6CF6 ('essentials.', 'forever.', 'Stack'). Dark navy text #101337 on light section.
